column1: # The shared ordinal scale of penalties (a convention, printed with every reference): 0 none, 1 restitution or a
# duty, 2 a fine or a single payment, 3 a fine as a multiple of the harm, 4 corporal, 5 liberty (arrest, restraint,
# imprisonment), 6 exclusion (karet, «cut off», exile), 7 capital. The heaviest pattern found in a penalty sets it.
